selection: Sorted unique IDs: pants plus jeans/denim text; screening only
notes: Bulk mode verifies official MD5; range mode has no full-archive checksum. Source splits are not research splits.
claim: acquisition and visual screening only; no retrieval-quality evidence

visual_review.criterion: Visible denim-like construction/texture, seams/pockets/wash and interpretable garment view. Exclude ambiguous smooth fabrics, obvious non-denim/sportswear, multiple target garments, folded or close-up-only views. This is visual screening, not physical material certification or relevance grading.
visual_review.limits: Catalog/studio-dominated, default low-resolution GLAMI images. Entire 1200-image corpus not cleared. Some coated/colored/white denim excluded as visually uncertain; blue/gray bias remains.
